channels.title: One AI receptionist on your website and on the phone
channels.intro: The Aibooking.dk AI receptionist meets customers where they reach out: first on your website with the AI Voice Widget, then on the phone when they call, and, as an add-on, with outbound calls. All three channels share the same knowledge, the same calendar and the same dashboard.

widget.label: 1 · AI Voice Widget
widget.title: AI Voice Widget: the receptionist on your website
widget.text: Most customers find you on your website first — often in the evening, after you have closed. The AI Voice Widget answers them instantly, by text, dictation or a real spoken conversation in the browser, and books the appointment straight into your calendar while interest is at its peak.
points: Chat, dictation and real-time voice in one widget
Answers from your knowledge base: text, website or PDF
Books, moves and cancels in Google Calendar, Outlook or Cal.com
Added with a single script to any kind of website
widget.imageAlt: AI Voice Widget on a website where the customer asks to book an appointment and the AI replies
widget.link: More about the AI Voice Widget

inbound.label: 2 · Inbound calls
inbound.title: AI phone answering for inbound calls
inbound.text: When a customer calls, the AI receptionist answers on your own number. It introduces itself as a digital assistant, understands the request, answers questions and books — even when the line is busy, at lunch and after closing time.
points: Keep your number — forward always, after hours or when busy
Many calls at once, no phone queue
Recording, transcript and summary of every call
Conversations in English, Danish, German, Spanish, French or Portuguese
inbound.imageAlt: Dashboard showing an inbound call at 8:08 PM with recording, summary, booking and transcript

outbound.label: 3 · Outbound calls
outbound.title: Outbound AI calls when you want to reach out
outbound.text: With the outbound add-on, the AI calls out from a list you upload: customers who haven't booked in a while, leads who asked to be contacted, or follow-ups on a quote — within the time windows you choose.
points: Campaigns from your own customer lists
Call windows, so calls only go out at suitable times
Same voice, knowledge and calendar as inbound calls
outbound.note: Outbound calling is a separate add-on with its own price and runs in its own module.

combined.title: Widget, phone and outbound calls in one solution — an example
combined.intro: Here is a week at a hair salon that uses the whole AI receptionist. The customer switches channels along the way, but the AI follows her throughout, because everything is gathered in one place.

steps.title: Sophie books on the website
steps.text: Sophie asks the widget what a women's cut costs and whether there is a slot on Saturday. The widget answers from the salon's price list and books Saturday at 11:30. The confirmation arrives straight away by email.

steps.title: She calls to move the appointment
steps.text: Every stylist is with a client, so the AI receptionist takes the call. It finds Sophie's booking, checks it is really her and moves it to Friday at 3:00 PM.

steps.title: The salon reaches out
steps.text: An outbound campaign calls customers who haven't visited in more than two months and offers them a free slot next week.

steps.title: The owner sees it all in one place
steps.text: Bookings from both the widget and the phone are in the calendar. The dashboard holds every conversation with recording, transcript and summary — no sticky notes, no lost messages.

combined.imageAlt: The dashboard's booking list with bookings, moves and cancellations from both the phone receptionist and the website assistant
combined.caption: Bookings from the phone receptionist (blue) and the website assistant (orange) in one dashboard.

benefits.title: One knowledge base
benefits.text: Update prices and opening hours once, and the widget and phone give the same answers.

benefits.title: One calendar
benefits.text: No double bookings, whether the customer types, talks or calls.

benefits.title: One overview
benefits.text: Every conversation and booking from every channel in the same dashboard and app.

faq.question: What is an AI receptionist?
faq.answer: An AI receptionist is a digital assistant that greets your customers on your website and on the phone. At Aibooking.dk it consists of the AI Voice Widget on your website, AI phone answering for inbound calls and — as an add-on — outbound calls. It answers from your own information, books in your calendar and saves every conversation in the dashboard.

faq.question: Do I need both the widget and the phone?
faq.answer: No. You can start with one channel — say only the widget on your website, or only the phone after hours — and add the others later. They share the knowledge base, calendar and dashboard, so your information doesn't need to be set up again.
